question: What ritual actions are prohibited when the substance has not been consecrated?
premises: Consecration of the substance is a required condition
Remembrance and recitation are ritual actions
Without consecration these actions must not be performed
inference: Without consecration of the substance, one should neither remember nor recite; there is no doubt.
uncertainties: The object of remembrance and recitation is implied from context.
plain_english: Without consecration of the substance, one should neither remember nor recite; there is no doubt about this.
